about_the_game:
“War takes everything from us — yet sometimes, it gives us someone to protect.”

Emotional Narrative: Experience the Gallipoli campaign through the eyes of Captain Timur and a lost child. A journey inspired by real historical letters and accounts.

Tactical Stealth & Survival: Evade enemy patrols and navigate through dangerous gas clouds in the trenches. Every step counts when you are protecting a life.

Environmental Puzzles: Solve clever puzzles to clear paths through destroyed villages and collapsing tunnels.

Cinematic Hand-Drawn Art: Immerse yourself in the atmospheric trenches and sun-scorched landscapes of 1915, brought to life with a unique 2D visual style.

Historical Authenticity: Witness the untold stories of the Ottoman front through a narrative deeply inspired by real events, soldier letters, and the harsh reality of the Gallipoli Campaign.

A Forgotten Front. A Lost Child. A Fading Hope.

Gallipoli Trenches: The Forgotten Front is a deeply emotional, story-driven 2D adventure set during the Gallipoli Campaign of World War I.

You play as Captain Timur, a young Ottoman officer serving under Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, whose mission takes an unexpected turn when he discovers a lone surviving child in a devastated village.

Bound by duty and compassion, Timur must guide the girl through the chaos of collapsing trenches, burning hillsides, and shattered souls.

Inspired by real events of the Gallipoli Campaign, Gallipoli Trenches captures the forgotten human stories of World War I from the Ottoman front.

A Cinematic 2D Journey Through History

From the sun-scorched cliffs of Gallipoli to the rain-soaked tunnels beneath the front lines, relive one of the most unforgettable moments of the First World War.
With hand-drawn visuals, historical depth, and emotional storytelling, Gallipoli Trenches brings history to life through the eyes of ordinary people caught in extraordinary times.

Experience Humanity Amid Destruction

Guide Captain Timur and the child through the remnants of war — evade patrols, solve environmental puzzles, and survive gas fields and bombardments.
Through moments of silence, kindness, and sacrifice, discover that even in war, humanity remains the strongest weapon of all.

Post-Release Plans

  • A Free Challenge Mode 

  • New Historical Scenes Update 

  • Soundtrack Release

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains depictions of war-related violence and emotional distress. Scenes include explosions, gunfire, wounded soldiers, and the aftermath of battle, but without graphic gore. Themes of loss and survival are central to the story. There is no sexual content or drug use.

short_description: A story-driven 2D adventure set in the Gallipoli Campaign of WWI. Play as Ottoman Captain Timur under Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, facing the British and ANZAC forces while rescuing a lost child and guiding her through the horrors of war — a heartfelt tale of courage and humanity on the forgotten front.
